items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: So I put August in that band with a given name... So I had Clarence on the banjo and I took August on bass.

ctx.x: At 16 I got 11 living. So we played together. Later on then the job kind of came out and we went and played down by the alley. I put my brother in the band August too. I got August in that band with a given name. I know we played up there. So later on we pulled around and see what we did that job. That's right. We got out the band, me and August. So they went playing down by the alley. I wonder if you could tell me some more about that alley because that's right next to the St. Bernard market. Yeah. Well I didn't…
What kind of places were there? Were there several clubs or speakeasies or what were in there?
